GservRequest.description: One line of gserv output, or the run finishing.

code.description: gserv's exit code, absent when srcds's auto-reap took the status first.

error.description: Set instead of a code when the verb was refused or gserv could not start.

identifier.description: Echoes the identifier the run was started with.

kind.description: Which stream the line came from; absent on the final message.
